title: Inventory Evidence Manifest and Provenance
selectedSlice: B — explicit caller-supplied inventory evidence-set manifest/provenance
purpose: Represent the exact immutable inventory evidence set used or observed for one exact SKU without claiming that the set is complete, current, authoritative, or tied to a durable point-in-time database cutoff.

manifest.batches: Deterministically ordered exact production-batch id/version references, each carrying the exact movement IDs attributed to that supplied evidence entry.
manifest.provenance: Caller-supplied bounded attribution and opaque sourceReference.

rules: The manifest is pure, synchronous and persistence-free.
The manifest records an explicitly supplied evidence set only.
An empty batch set is valid.
A batch entry may contain an empty movement set.
Every SKU, batch and movement identity is canonical.
Every version is a positive safe integer.
At most 128 batch entries may be supplied.
At most 128 movement identities may be supplied per batch.
Exact batch id/version identities must be unique.
A physical inventory movement identity may appear only once across the entire manifest.
Batch entries are sorted deterministically by batch id and then batch version.
Movement identities inside each batch entry are sorted deterministically.
The result is detached and deeply frozen.
Provenance is caller supplied and does not authenticate its source.
sourceReference is opaque and must not be interpreted as a database cursor or cutoff.
The manifest does not prove that all persisted batches were enumerated.
The manifest does not prove that all persisted movements were enumerated.
The manifest does not prove one consistent database snapshot across multiple reads.
The manifest does not establish an as-of timestamp, high-water mark or transaction boundary.
The manifest does not calculate a recorded physical balance.
The manifest does not establish authoritative current quantity-on-hand.
The manifest does not establish availability, capacity, reservation, orderability, checkout or payment readiness.
No migration change or migration execution occurs.
deferred: Trusted database snapshot or durable cutoff semantics.
Composition of persisted reads into recorded batch balances.
Composition of persisted batch balances into an exact-SKU recorded balance.
